panels.title: Cowrie hits (80%)
panels.description: Distinct src_ip values over the range, excluding pod-CIDR (10.244.x.x) kubelet/health-probe noise. NOTE: 80/20 is the haproxy WEIGHT, which assigns new unique source IPs -- it is NOT the observed connection share. `stick on src` pins each attacker IP to one honeypot, so a single high-volume attacker skews the counts hard: over one 6h window the real split was beelzebub 1554 / cowrie 366 (81/19) while the weights were 50/50, because one IP (109.160.32.38) contributed 1439 of those. Compare "Unique Attacker IPs" for the weighted behaviour.

Compare "Unique Attacker IPs" for the weighted behaviour.

panels.title: [beelzebub] Captured Commands (live)
panels.description: Every command an attacker typed into the honeypot shell (cowrie.command.input). Expand a line to see src_ip, session, username and the full input. This is the primary command-capture feed.

targets.expr: {namespace="honeypot", container="beelzebub"} | json | event_Msg=`SSH Raw Command` | line_format "{{.event_SourceIp}}  [{{.event_ID}}]  $ {{.event_Command}}"

panels.title: [beelzebub] Login Attempts vs Terminal Sessions
panels.description: Beelzebub emits no success/failed distinction - every login event is Msg="New SSH Login Attempt" with Status="Stateless". The old panel ran the SAME query twice and labelled them success/failed. Now compares attempts against sessions that actually reached a terminal.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="honeypot", container="beelzebub"} | json | event_Msg=`New SSH Login Attempt` [$__interval]))
sum(count_over_time({namespace="honeypot", container="beelzebub"} | json | event_Msg=`New SSH Terminal Session` [$__interval]))

panels.title: [beelzebub] Sessions Over Time
panels.description: Uses Msg="New SSH Terminal Session". The old query filtered event_SourceIp!~"10.244..*", which excluded 100% of rows because beelzebub only ever sees haproxy pod IP (no PROXY protocol).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="honeypot", container="beelzebub"} | json | event_Msg=`New SSH Terminal Session` [$__interval]))

panels.title: [beelzebub] Top Commands
panels.description: Most frequently executed commands captured from interactive sessions (cowrie.command.input).

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (event_Command) (count_over_time({namespace="honeypot", container="beelzebub"} | json | event_Msg=`SSH Raw Command` | event_Command!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: [beelzebub] Captured Credentials
panels.description: Username+password pairs tried against the beelzebub SSH tier. Requires Loki max_query_series >= ~5000 (raised from 500 in loki/helmrelease.yaml): credential-stuffing is inherently high-cardinality -- 491 distinct pairs at 2h, 837 distinct passwords at 24h. If this errors with "maximum of series reached" again, the range has outgrown the limit; narrow the range or raise it further.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (event_User, event_Password) (count_over_time({namespace="honeypot", container="beelzebub"} | json | event_Msg=`New SSH Login Attempt` [$__range])))

panels.title: [beelzebub] Event Breakdown
panels.description: Was filtering eventid!="" (a COWRIE field) with no container filter, so it displayed COWRIE events under a beelzebub heading.

panels.title: [beelzebub] Honeypot-Detection Attempts (24h)
panels.description: GPU/CPU fingerprinting commands (uname, lspci, lscpu, nproc, nvidia-smi, ipinfo.io). Old sentinels matched 0 lines anywhere.

panels.title: [beelzebub] Distinct Recon Source IPs (24h)
panels.description: External IPs that ran the fingerprinting recon.

panels.title: [beelzebub] Recon / Detection Commands (live)
panels.description: The actual recon commands attackers run to fingerprint the box.

targets.expr: {namespace="honeypot", container="beelzebub"} | json | event_Msg=`SSH Raw Command` |~ `uname|lspci|lscpu|nproc|nvidia-smi|ipinfo|/proc/cpuinfo` | line_format "{{.event_SourceIp}} $ {{.event_Command}}"

panels.title: [beelzebub] Commands Captured
panels.description: Total cowrie.command.input events over the selected range. These come only from real interactive sessions (not health probes).

panels.title: [beelzebub] Login Attempts
panels.description: Old query filtered event_SourceIp!~"10.244..*" which excluded everything (beelzebub only sees haproxy pod IP).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="honeypot", container="beelzebub"} | json | event_Msg=`New SSH Login Attempt` [$__range]))

panels.title: [beelzebub] Terminal Sessions
panels.description: Renamed: the old "Failed Logins" ran the same query as Login Attempts. Beelzebub has no failure signal; this now counts sessions that reached a terminal.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="honeypot", container="beelzebub"} | json | event_Msg=`New SSH Terminal Session` [$__range]))

panels.title: Falco runtime tripwire (breach = attacker escaped the emulation)
HONEYPOT BREACH (Falco) — should ALWAYS be empty
panels.description: Falco fires this if a real process/exec/sensitive-read happens inside the honeypot pods — i.e. someone broke OUT of the Cowrie/Beelzebub emulation into the actual container. Any line here is a CRITICAL incident.
